short_title: Audit of NASA's Deep Space Network (IG-23-016) - DAEP cost growth, schedule delay and DSN oversubscription
journal_or_series: NASA Office of Inspector General audit report IG-23-016 (A-22-01-00-MSD), July 12 2023
authors_short: NASA Office of Inspector General (Office of Audits)
access_status: full_text_hosted - 2.7 MB PDF pulled live from oig.nasa.gov R85 (2026-09-30); US government work, public domain; key numbers with page locations in extracted_data/r85_dsn_oig_audits_key_numbers.csv
pipeline_mapping: **DSN capacity/cost context for operational_costs.csv 'Deep Space Network time'** - demand exceeds supply by as much as 40 percent (p3/p7) while the DSN supports nearly 60 NASA and international missions (p3); DAEP life-cycle cost $419M at project start in 2010 -> **$706M by end FY2022 (+$287M / +68 percent**, p4) on scope changes incl. a dish-pedestal rebuild and deferrals; committed $363.2M FY2010-FY2022 = $184M DSN-budget wedge + $179.2M Construction of Facilities (p14); Phase 1 planned $173.2M for Sep-2018 completion vs actual partial completion at $120.8M as of FY2022 (Table 2, p21). No per-hour aperture fee anywhere in the audit -> rc-030's route stays the 820-100 Rev H rate base + CPI chain.

short_title: NASA's Management of the Deep Space Network (IG-15-013) - DSN operating budget, FY2013 cut and DAEP history
journal_or_series: NASA Office of Inspector General audit report IG-15-013 (A-14-012-00), March 26 2015
authors_short: NASA Office of Inspector General (Office of Audits)
access_status: full_text_hosted - 4.6 MB PDF pulled live from oig.nasa.gov R85 (2026-09-30); US government work, public domain; key numbers with page locations in extracted_data/r85_dsn_oig_audits_key_numbers.csv
pipeline_mapping: **annual operating-cost anchor for 'Mission operations' and DSN context** - FY2014 DSN budget = **$210M** covering operations, maintenance and upgrades, executed by the JPL Project Office (p8); CSIRO's Canberra-site operating budget FY2014 = $19M (~100 staff, p9); SCaN cut of -$101.3M for FYs 2013-2019 forced DAEP delays and antenna closures/replanning (p3/p16), met by a $91.7M offset plan (Table 4, p18) plus $18.6M inflation exposure; updated DAEP life-cycle cost through FY2025 = **$393.1M** (+$30.7M vs the 2009 estimate, p21) - the first data point of the growth that IG-23-016 later reports as $419M -> $706M; 'NASA missions do not pay for use of the Network unless a unique technology must be added' (p12) - context for why DSN time is a chargeable line at all.
